predicates.title: SPF record missing or permissive
predicates.description: An accepted domain has no SPF record, an SPF record ending in +all/?all, or multiple SPF records, allowing third parties to send mail as the domain.
predicates.attack_vector: Sender spoofing -> phishing/business email compromise from a trusted domain
predicates.recommendation: Publish a single SPF record enumerating authorized senders and ending in -all (hard fail).

predicates.title: DMARC missing or policy set to none
predicates.description: An accepted domain has no DMARC record, uses p=none, lacks an rua reporting address, or sets pct<100, so spoofed mail failing SPF/DKIM is not rejected or quarantined and abuse is not reported.
predicates.attack_vector: Spoofed mail delivered to inbox -> phishing/BEC
predicates.recommendation: Publish DMARC with p=quarantine then p=reject after monitoring, with rua/ruf reporting and pct=100.

predicates.title: DKIM signing not enabled for accepted domain
predicates.description: DKIM is not configured/enabled for an accepted domain, or uses a weak 1024-bit key, weakening alignment and DMARC enforcement.
predicates.attack_vector: Missing message authentication weakens anti-spoofing and DMARC alignment
predicates.recommendation: Enable DKIM signing for every accepted domain with 2048-bit keys; rotate periodically.

predicates.title: Anti-phishing / spoof protection weak or disabled
predicates.description: Defender for Office 365 anti-phishing protection is missing or weak — no policy applied, or spoof intelligence / mailbox intelligence / impersonation protection disabled.
predicates.attack_vector: Impersonation and spoof phishing reach users uninspected
predicates.recommendation: Enable anti-phishing with spoof intelligence, mailbox intelligence and impersonation protection; set actions to quarantine.

predicates.title: Safe Links / Safe Attachments not enforced
predicates.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Safe Links and/or Safe Attachments are disabled or not applied to all recipients, leaving malicious URLs and payloads uninspected.
predicates.attack_vector: Malicious link/attachment delivered -> malware / credential theft
predicates.recommendation: Enable Safe Links and Safe Attachments for all users (requires Defender for Office 365 licensing).

predicates.title: Risky mail-flow / transport rule
predicates.description: A transport rule bypasses spam filtering (SCL -1), auto-forwards mail externally, or broadly allow-lists senders/domains/IPs.
predicates.attack_vector: Filter-bypass for phishing, or external auto-forward for data exfiltration
predicates.recommendation: Remove blanket SCL -1 and broad allow-lists; block/limit external auto-forwarding; scope exceptions narrowly.

predicates.title: External auto-forwarding not restricted
predicates.description: The outbound spam policy permits automatic external forwarding, enabling silent mailbox data exfiltration via inbox rules.
predicates.attack_vector: Compromised mailbox auto-forwards to attacker -> data exfiltration
predicates.recommendation: Set outbound auto-forwarding to Off (or controlled), and alert on new forwarding rules.
